name: openai/gpt-5
description: GPT-5 is OpenAI's reasoning model released in August 2025 for coding, reasoning and agentic tasks across domains, accepting text and image input and producing text. OpenAI describes it as a coding collaborator for fixing bugs, editing code and answering questions about complex codebases, with configurable reasoning effort that includes a minimal setting for quicker replies. OpenAI now labels it a previous model, and later GPT-5.x releases are its recommended successors for fresh work.
